findings.reason: as written the control proves nothing, so a worker can pass the case without the waiter ever absorbing a mark, which is the one behaviour case (5) exists to prove; the control must name a mutation the design permits that actually loses the row (a waiter answered from the build as it stood before the marks were consumed).
findings.text: case (5) records the mark "while that reader is still held inside the path" and the deliverable has that same reader consume every mark recorded while it ran before it returns, so the first reader's rows already carry the added file; a waiter handed the leader's rows therefore carries it too, and the declared control cannot redden the case

— the deliverable scopes its single-reader guarantee to "the whole cache-miss path in `index_rows`", but the discovery signature reads the same covered set through `_covered_files` → `_reuse_covered` (`reckon/metadata_index.py:975-1006`), which is outside that path and outside the in-flight registry, so a `/_discover` read arriving during a cold `/_index` read still stats every recorded directory - WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: no — REASON: the section's measure and its write paths are explicitly the `index_rows` path, so nothing a worker is asked to build depends on this; it is recorded so the author can state the exclusion rather than let a reader infer a guarantee the section does not make.
